meta.originalInput: The internet convinced you dopamine is a fuel tank you drain by looking at your phone. That is pure fiction. Dopamine isn't pleasure—it is the molecule of anticipation. When you scroll, your brain isn't out of dopamine; algorithms artificially raised your baseline reward threshold. You didn't lose motivation; ordinary reality just cannot compete with instant novelty. Stop extreme seven-day detoxes. Simply delay your first high-stimulation app by sixty minutes every morning, and bundle effort before reward. Lower the threshold, and deep focus returns instantly.
